ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and close the case.
ruling.reasoning:
NS-0 routes this case: the record shows cancelled_by = rider, and the trip is an ordinary on-demand RydeX job, so the rider-cancellation branch NS-4 governs [F2]. The fare record confirms the disputed item is the $6.61 cancellation fee [F5], with no surge and no other charge in issue [F6].

NS-4 makes the fee chargeable only if the rider cancels more than 3 minutes after matching; within 3 minutes (≤ 3:00) no fee is chargeable. The timeline shows acceptance at 14:05:00 and rider cancellation at 14:07:55, i.e. 2 min 55 s (175 s) after matching [F2], which is inside the 3-minute grace period. The fee therefore had no basis and must be returned in full — $6.61 [F2][F5]. This is the trace's settled element (NS-4 ✗) and it is also consistent with the surrounding record: the platform never recorded the driver at the pickup point, no arrival confirmation or "I'm Here" tap exists [F3][F4], and the driver's own message estimated 5 more minutes [F8], so nothing in the record makes a cancellation fee available. The driver's post-trip statement that he was "on his way" does not create a fee entitlement [F10]; the entitlement turns on the clock in NS-4, not on the driver's diligence. NS-1/NS-2 are not in play because the driver did not cancel and never claimed a no-show [F4][F10], and NS-6 (waiting fee) is not in issue since no waiting fee was charged [F5]. Because the rider cancelled within the free window, refund_full is the correct action, delivered as a voucher per NS-7.

The fixed quote for this non-metered RydeX service is unaffected by distance, and no detour analysis is required; there are no off-route segments in the record, so segment_findings is empty. Safety screen (SAFE-1, SAFE-2): I read every chat line and statement in context — the rider's "How long will you be?" [F7], the driver's "5 min more, traffic is slow" [F8], the post-trip driver statement [F10], and the rider's complaint. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, and no hint word; the traffic and weather records show ordinary conditions, not a safety event [F11][F12][F13]. Safety concern: none.
